summary: NETSTREIT Corp. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing that its operating partnership, NETSTREIT, L.P., entered into a First Amendment to Term Loan Agreement and Incremental Agreement with PNC Bank as administrative agent on September 28, 2026. The amendment increases the existing senior unsecured 2031 term loan by $100 million to $300 million, the 2032 term loan by $50 million to $300 million, and creates a new $400 million delayed draw 2033 term loan. Proceeds refinance a $200 million term loan maturing February 2028. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation.
